description: Yifu 本地任务运行器 + 只读监视 UI。一条标准命令 (python -m pipeline_modules.harness run) 完成校验、建任务、启动唯一 worker 并返回 run_id；worker 串行执行 main.py、写 progress.json 心跳、结束后做输出验证并生成 artifact manifest。Pipeline Monitor (FastAPI, http://127.0.0.1:8766) 完全只读：刷新页面不会启动任何任务。

recommended_entrypoint.description: 推荐且唯一推荐的提交方式。校验 sample_dir（须在 analysis root 下）与 config.json，按样本去重（同一样本已有 queued/running 任务时返回原 run_id），创建任务记录，启动或复用唯一 detached worker，立即打印 {run_id, log_path, progress_path, monitor} 后退出。关闭终端不影响运行。

run_id.description: <utcstamp>-<sample-slug>，用于 cancel/list 与 Monitor 查看

agent_rules: 宗旨：少命令（只用标准入口，不写 run.py）、不猜（只认状态和结构化错误，不解析日志）、少改（普通失败不引发改代码）。需要新代码时先与用户确认放置位置：现有仓库，还是项目文件夹下用完即删。完整规则见仓库根 AGENTS.md。

rules: Whole-brain production runs must avoid TIFF intermediates: stream Imaris .ims directly with pipeline_modules.preprocessing.ims_to_zarr and pre-create the inputs main.py skips on (ch<signal>.zarr, ch<reg>_downsample/volume.nii.gz, sample_dir/original_shape.json). See pipeline_modules/preprocessing/capability_manifest.json.

Preprocessing/enhancement is OFF by default in production configs (every preprocessing.*.apply=false) so segmentation thresholds operate on raw stored intensities and stay comparable across samples and batches.
标准流程一律用 run_sample 入口提交。main.py 表达不了的定制多步流程（如 ims->zarr->segmentation->masked ims）才用 attach_external 挂载外部 driver；不允许手工编辑 queue 文件。

One job runs at a time (single worker, exclusive lock). To wait for the current run, poll python -m pipeline_modules.harness list or GET /api/jobs; never launch heavy pipelines outside the worker while a job is running.

entrypoints.description: 标准提交入口（同 recommended_entrypoint）。--extra-arg 只接受白名单 flag：--skip_registration / --only_tubule / --only_region_analysis；不接受任意 shell 命令。

sample_dir.description: Must be a subdirectory of the analysis root, not the _active/jobs|runs bookkeeping folders

job.description: Queued job record; run_id printed as JSON on stdout

entrypoints.description: Submit 前的一次只读校验：sample_dir、config.json、pipeline mode、required outputs 与当前 worker 状态。不创建任务。
协作式取消：写 cancel flag，worker 终止 pipeline 进程树并把任务标记 cancelled。queued 任务直接取消。
只读列出任务（含 display_status、heartbeat_age_s、duration_s、结构化 error）。REST 等价：GET http://127.0.0.1:8766/api/jobs —— GET 不会启动任何任务。
内部入口：detached 串行 worker。由 run/POST 自动启动，一般不需要手动调用。持有 _active/worker.lock 独占锁；空闲 30 分钟自动退出；崩溃重启后会收养仍存活的 pipeline 子进程，或把失去心跳的 running 任务标记 stalled。

exit.description: 0 on idle timeout or clean stop

entrypoints.description: LEGACY/定制流程：把 main.py 表达不了的自定义 driver 挂到 PM。状态文件首行 RUNNING/ALL DONE/FAILED/CANCELLED，第二行 started_at ISO。同一样本重复 attach 会更新而不是复制记录。标准流程不要用这个，用 run。
LEGACY：只入队不启动 worker（与旧脚本兼容）。推荐改用 run_sample。

启动 Pipeline Monitor（只读 UI）。REST：GET /api/meta, GET /api/jobs（只读）, GET /api/jobs/{id}/log, GET /api/jobs/{id}/artifacts, POST /api/jobs（提交+启动 worker）, POST /api/queue/start（显式启动 worker）, POST /api/jobs/{id}/cancel, POST /api/queue/cancel, DELETE /api/jobs/{id}, POST /api/open。GET 请求永远不会启动任务。

launch_stability_policy.origin: Incidents 2026-09-18..23 (YF2025063002 vessel batch) distilled into the harness itself: the detached worker replaces cmd/schtasks driver chains, and success is decided by output verification instead of status-file text.
rules: The worker is spawned DETACHED (own log file, no inherited console handles); closing the submitting terminal or the Monitor never kills a run.
No interactive input() anywhere in the chain; all flags are explicit.
Process exit codes and log text are NEVER the verdict: succeeded requires exit 0 AND required outputs exist AND readable AND artifact manifest written (pipeline_modules/harness/verify.py).
Worker crash recovery: on restart, still-alive pipeline pids are adopted; dead ones become stalled with a structured STALLED error (retryable), never succeeded.
Heartbeats: worker stamps progress.json heartbeat_at every 15 s; older than 120 s (or dead worker) displays as stalled.
Kill by exact PID (taskkill /T /F via the cooperative cancel flag), never by command-substring sweeps.
historical_reference: 旧 driver 契约（两行 status 文件、marker、watchdog）仍适用于 attach_external 的自定义流程；标准流程已由 worker + verifier 取代。

queue_semantics.storage: YIFU_ANALYSIS_ROOT/_active: queue.json (ordered ids), jobs/*.json (records), runs/<job_id>/ (progress.json + stdout.log + artifacts.json + cancel.flag), worker.json (worker liveness), worker.lock (exclusive), logs/worker.log

status_meanings.running: runner 进程和 heartbeat 正常
status_meanings.verifying: 内部状态：程序已结束，正在验证输出
status_meanings.succeeded: 正常结束 AND required outputs 存在 AND 可读取 AND artifact manifest 写入
status_meanings.failed: 异常退出或输出验证失败（带结构化 error）
status_meanings.stalled: worker/心跳消失，无法确认是否仍在执行（retryable）

queue_semantics.serial: Single detached worker holds an exclusive lock; one running job at a time across kinds
queue_semantics.dedupe: run 命令对同一样本的 queued/running/verifying 任务去重，返回原 run_id
queue_semantics.readonly_monitor: GET /api/jobs 与页面刷新不做任何状态变更；只有 提交/显式启动 worker/取消/worker 推进队列 会改变状态

progress_protocol.unknown_units: unit_total 为 null 表示进度未知；UI 显示『进度未知』，禁止伪造百分比或 ETA
